preconditions.description: The input is a single string of small Latin letters with length from 1 to 10^5 characters.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(k, int) and k >= 0 and k <= len(stdout_parts)
postconditions.description: k is an integer representing the number of nonempty parts of the password in the answer.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(part, tuple) and len(part) == 2 for part in stdout_parts)
postconditions.description: Each part in the output is a tuple of two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(stdin) and li > 0 for xi, li in stdout_parts)
postconditions.description: Each starting position xi is an integer from 1 to the length of the input string, and each length li is positive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_parts[i][0] < stdout_parts[i+1][0] for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: The parts are output in order of increasing starting position xi.

postconditions.expression: sum(li for xi, li in stdout_parts) == len(password)
postconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of the parts equals the length of the password.
The middle part has an odd length.

postconditions.expression: password == ''.join(stdin[xi-1:xi-1+li] for xi, li in stdout_parts)
postconditions.description: The concatenation of the parts reconstructs the password.
